details.description: Enhanced Finance is a beta model in Deepgram's Enhanced speech-to-text tier, optimized for multiple speakers with varying audio quality, such as a typical earnings call, with vocabulary heavily oriented toward finance. Deepgram states Enhanced-tier models generally have higher accuracy and better word recognition than its Base tier, including significantly better handling of uncommon words. Deepgram's Models & Languages Overview currently groups the Enhanced tier, together with Base and Nova 1, under "Legacy Models", behind its newer Nova-3 and Flux offerings.
advantages: Deepgram describes it as optimized for multiple speakers with varying audio quality, such as a typical earnings call, with vocabulary heavily oriented toward finance.
Deepgram states Enhanced-tier models generally have higher accuracy and better word recognition than its Base-tier models, and handle uncommon words significantly better.
disadvantages: Deepgram labels this model "beta" on its Model Options page.
Deepgram groups the Enhanced tier under "Legacy Models" in its Models & Languages Overview, alongside Base and Nova 1.
Supports English only, per Deepgram's language documentation.
use_cases: Transcribing earnings calls and other multi-speaker financial audio with varying audio quality
Transcription tasks needing finance-oriented vocabulary recognition

notes: No word-error-rate or other accuracy figures specific to enhanced-finance were found on Deepgram's maker pages, so evaluations is left empty. The catalog carries no deprecation_date for this model.
